title: Exposing the Honey Influencer Scam
summary: MegaLag investigates PayPal's Honey browser extension, showing how it swaps affiliate attribution and was promoted by large YouTube influencers. It includes technical demonstrations of the affiliate tag replacement in browser dev tools.
why: HN treats it as top-tier investigative journalism on YouTube and the video that triggered lawsuits against Honey.

quote.text: one of the best pieces of investigative journalism I've seen on youtube
